item.title: Welcome to WorldLink
item.description: Established in 1997, WorldLink was the first sales representation organization dedicated exclusively to the Infomercial and Direct Response Media Business. Today, WorldLink sells over 200,000 half-hours and over 3.6 million DR spots on an annual basis. WorldLink has grown from a boutique Infomercial and DR sales company to a global marketing company representing blue chip clients and media properties including broadcast (both traditional broadcast and D2 stations), cable, syndication & satellite
